The necromancer {npc:Omrabas}, hidden in the ruins of {wiki:Drefia|Drefia}, wants to come back to life. Over three volumes you gather body parts for him, consecrate the five altars of the star-shaped room and recover the five pieces of an enchantment scroll. In the end the ritual fails (the scroll was a chicken soup recipe!) and Omrabas, furious, gives you the {item:Nail Case}, needed to tame the {wiki:Hellgrip|Hellgrip} mount.
Loose Stone Pile leading to Omrabas's hideout, Drefia
